page_size.note: NOT part of the reported measurement. Apple Silicon commonly uses 16 KiB pages, but issue #4157 does not state it and nothing here established it.

max_user_address.source: shadps4-emu/shadPS4@d392abe src/core/address_space.cpp:52, USER_MAX = 0x5FFFFFFFFFFF (inclusive) for the non-Linux non-FreeBSD branch
max_user_address.note: Derived from shadPS4's own constant, not from the issue's measurement. Half-open exclusive end is the inclusive maximum plus one.

anonymous_mapping_supported.source: shadps4-emu/shadPS4 issue #4157: the reporter's test program successfully mapped at 0x7000000000 and above
anonymous_mapping_supported.note: Mapping works on this host; only specific bands are refused.

exact_mapping.source: shadps4-emu/shadPS4 issue #4157: MAP_FIXED succeeded outside the reserved bands and returned ENOMEM inside them

hinted_mapping_may_relocate.source: shadps4-emu/shadPS4 issue #4157: "Without MAP_FIXED (hint-only), all hints in the gap redirect to 0x7000000000."
hinted_mapping_may_relocate.note: A measured relocation, not merely the POSIX permission to relocate. The mapping SUCCEEDS at a different address, which is exactly the silent contract degradation this project exists to catch.

fixed_noreplace_available.note: macOS has no MAP_FIXED_NOREPLACE equivalent that this fixture establishes.

write_execute_simultaneous.note: Not addressed by issue #4157. Left unknown rather than carried over from another fixture.

unavailable_ranges.note: Rosetta 2 commpage. shadps4-emu/shadPS4 issue #4157 states 0xFC0000000-0xFFFFFFFFF and reports that a test program compiled as x86_64 under Rosetta 2 received ENOMEM for MAP_FIXED at every address tested in this band.

Apple unified-memory GPU carveout. shadps4-emu/shadPS4 issue #4157 reports ENOMEM for MAP_FIXED at every address tested from 0xFC0000000 through ~0x6FC0000000, explicitly including 0x1307200000. NOTE: shadPS4's own source treats the band as ending at 0x6FFFFFFFFF (USER_MIN 0x7000000000), a slightly more conservative bound than the issue's ~0x6FC0000000. The two disagree about the last 1 GiB; neither reading changes the verdict for 0x1307200000.

available_ranges.note: shadps4-emu/shadPS4 issue #4157: "OK: 0x7000000000". Only the one page the reporter actually tested is recorded; the rest of the user region was not enumerated and is therefore absent rather than assumed.

warnings: THIS PROFILE WAS NOT MEASURED BY rs-env-probe. Its address-range facts are a THIRD-PARTY REPORTED MEASUREMENT transcribed from shadps4-emu/shadPS4 issue #4157, in which the reporter describes compiling and running a test program as x86_64 under Rosetta 2 and observing ENOMEM for MAP_FIXED across the band. We did not reproduce it and cannot.

Evidence class 'observed_invariant' was chosen deliberately over 'measured_capability'. measured_capability means rs-env-probe observed it on the host in front of us. A credible reported observation we cannot reproduce is evidence, not proof - so every finding derived from these ranges is capped at OBSERVED_INVARIANT and can never be labelled PROVEN.

Facts NOT covered by the report - page size, W^X policy, JIT entitlement, minimum mappable address - are left unknown rather than copied from the sibling fixtures. Copying them would manufacture agreement between two documents that measured different things.

notes: Replace with the output of `rs-env-probe vm` run on a real Apple Silicon host to upgrade these facts to measured_capability. Until then this is the strongest macOS evidence available and it is still not a measurement of your machine.
Reported environment: Apple M4 Max, 64 GB, macOS 15.x (Darwin 25.3.0), binary is Mach-O 64-bit x86_64 under Rosetta 2.
